0022600041.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (8-3, 1st in the Northwest, 4th in the West) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-10, 14th in the West) for the Trail Blazers' 12th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. Portland has won two straight and is 7-3 over its last ten games, while Sacramento has dropped four in a row and is 0-6 at home. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Chris Youngblood (foot bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), with Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise) also day-to-day and a game-time decision. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 128-120 win in Sacramento on October 23, and it also won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season.
